description: FanDuel Sportsbook (New Jersey) game lines for NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, WNBA and college football/basketball: each listed game with FanDuel event ID, away/home team, start time and the moneyline, spread (puck line in NHL) and total, every price in American and decimal odds with the line. Read from the JSON FanDuel's own web app loads; only games FanDuel currently lists, no props or futures. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
